data.name: Schema
FindOperation
data.value: SELECT request_hash AS "RequestHash", known_ticks AS "KnownTicks", payload AS "Payload", completed AS "Completed" FROM company_public_knowledge_operations WHERE actor_id=@actor AND company_id=@company AND operation=@operation AND idempotency_key=@key

data.name: LastCompanyTime
data.value: SELECT GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(known_ticks) FROM company_public_knowledge_operations WHERE company_id=@company),0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(known_ticks) FROM company_knowledge_revisions WHERE category='company' AND entity_id=@company),0))

data.name: CompleteOperation
data.value: UPDATE company_public_knowledge_operations SET completed=TRUE WHERE actor_id=@actor AND company_id=@company AND operation=@operation AND idempotency_key=@key AND request_hash=@requestHash AND completed=FALSE
